'''Bruno N Rémillard''' (born July 7, 1961) is a Canadian mathematical statistician and an honorary professor at [[HEC Montréal]]. He is the 2019 Gold Medalist of the [[Statistical Society of Canada]]<ref name="SSC-2019">{{cite web | url=https://ssc.ca/en/awards/2019/bruno-remillard | title=SSC Award Winners in 2019 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref> and was inducted as a 2019 Fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]].<ref name="IMS-2019">{{cite web | url=https://imstat.org/2019/05/15/congratulations-to-the-2019-ims-fellows/ | title=IMS fellow 2019 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref> Rémillard was President of the [[Statistical Society of Canada]] in 2022-23.<ref name="presi">{{cite web | url=https://ssc.ca/en/about/board-directors | title=President SSC | access-date=15 July 2023}}</ref>

== Biography ==

Rémillard was born in [[Saint-Raphaël, Quebec]], Canada. He received a [[BSc]] and a [[MSc]] in mathematics from [[Université Laval]] in 1983 and 1985 and two years later a [[PhD]] in probability at [[Carleton University]] under the supervision of [[Donald A. Dawson]]. His dissertation was entitled "Large deviations and laws of the iterated logarithm for multidimensional diffusion processes with applications to diffusion processes with random coefficients."<ref name="PhD dissertation">{{cite web | url=https://curve.carleton.ca/system/files/etd/a173816e-da9f-482d-90f9-8f0b394f142d/etd_pdf/8bf37dcc9e6ed71a4a92189413f3bd31/remillard-largedeviationsandlawsoftheiteratedlogarithm.pdf | title=Large deviations and laws of the iterated logarithm for multidimensional diffusion processes with applications to diffusion processes with random coefficients.|access-date=June 4, 2021}}</ref> and earned him the Pierre-Robillard Award from the [[Statistical Society of Canada]] that recognizes the best PhD thesis defended in the relevant fields at a Canadian university in a given year.<ref name="Pierre Robillard Award">{{cite web | url=https://ssc.ca/en/awards/1988/bruno-remillard-laureat-prix-pierre-robillard-1988 | title=Pierre-Robillard Award winners|access-date=June 4, 2021}}</ref> After working as an NSERC postdoctoral fellow at [[Cornell University]], Rémillard joined the [[Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières]] in 1988. He was promoted to the rank of Associate in 1992 and became full professor in 1996. He settled at [[HEC Montréal]] in 2001.

== Publications ==

Rémillard has authored over 85 published papers, mostly in high-caliber international journals, in the fields of [[probability]], [[statistics]], and [[time series]] modelling. He has co-authored with [[Christian Genest]] nearly 20 papers in [[Annals of Probability|The Annals of Probability]], [[The Annals of Statistics]],  [[Bernoulli (journal)|Bernoulli]], [[Biometrika]], [[Journal of the American Statistical Association]], [[Journal of Multivariate Analysis]], etc.<ref name="SSC-2019">{{cite web | url=https://ssc.ca/en/awards/2019/bruno-remillard | title=SSC Award Winners in 2019 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref> He is one of the 23 scientists to have published in the four IMS Annals.<ref name="IMS-annals">{{cite web | url=https://imstat.org/2021/05/14/the-annals-quadfecta-23/ | title=The Annals Quadfecta 23 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref> He is the author of a graduate monograph and co-authored of three other books, including two undergraduate textbooks:
* Corina Reischer, Raymond Leblanc, Bruno Rémillard, and Denis Larocque, ''Théorie des probabilités: Problèmes et solutions.'', Presses de l'Université du Québec, Montréal, Canada, 2002 <ref name="theorieproba">{{cite web | url=https://www.puq.ca/catalogue/livres/theorie-des-probabilites-196.html | title=Théorie des probabilités: Problèmes et solutions| author1=Reischer, Corina | author2=Leblanc, Raymond | author3=Rémillard, Bruno | author4=Larocque, Denis| author-link3=Bruno Rémillard | access-date=June 4, 2021 }}</ref>
* Pierre Duchesne and Bruno Rémillard, ''Statistical modeling and analysis for complex data problems'', GERAD 25th Anniversary Series, Springer: New York, 2005 <ref name="statscompnet">{{cite book | url=https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9780387245546 | title=Statistical modeling and analysis for complex data problems | author1=Duchesne, Pierre | author2=Rémillard, Bruno| editor1-first=Pierre | editor1-last=Duchesne | editor2-first=Bruno | editor2-last=Rémillard | year=2005 | doi=10.1007/b105993 | isbn=978-0-387-24554-6 | author-link2=Bruno Rémillard | access-date=June 4, 2021 }}</ref>
* Pierre Del Moral, Bruno Rémillard, and Sylvain Rubenthaler,  ''Une introduction aux probabilités'', Éditions Ellipses, 2006 <ref name="introprob">{{cite web | url=https://www.editions-ellipses.fr/accueil/3334-une-introduction-aux-probabilites-9782729830434.html | title=Une introduction aux probabilités | author1=Del Moral, Pierre | author2=Rémillard, Bruno | author3=Rubenthaler, Sylvain | author-link2=Bruno Rémillard | access-date=June 4, 2021 }}</ref>
* B. Rémillard, ''Statistical methods for financial engineering'', Chapman and Hall/CRC, 2013.<ref name="statfining">{{cite web | url=https://www.routledge.com/Statistical-Methods-for-Financial-Engineering/Remillard/p/book/9781439856949 | title=Statistical Methods for Financial Engineering | author1=Rémillard, Bruno | author-link1=Bruno Rémillard | access-date=June 4, 2021 }}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==

* [[Statistical Society of Canada]] Pierre-Robillard Award 1988 <ref name="Pierre Robillard Award">{{cite web | url=https://ssc.ca/en/awards/1988/bruno-remillard-laureat-prix-pierre-robillard-1988 | title=Pierre-Robillard Award winners|access-date=June 4, 2021}}</ref>
* Elected Member of the [[International Statistical Institute]] 2000
* Best Paper Award [[Canadian Journal of Statistics]] 2003 <ref name="SSC-1988">{{cite web | url=https://ssc.ca/en/awards/2004/belkacem-abdous-kilani-ghoudi-and-bruno-remillard-laureats-prix-revue-canadienne | title=Canadian Journal of Statistics best paper award winners in 2004 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref>
* Pierre Laurin Award for Excellence in Research 2007 <ref name="pierrelaurin">{{cite web | url=https://www.hec.ca/en/news/2019/distinctions_b_remillard.html | title=Pierre Laurin Award in 2007 | date=26 September 2019 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref>
* Roger Charbonneau Award 2013 <ref name="rogerchar">{{cite web | url=https://www.gerad.ca/en/posts/334 | title=Roger Charbonneau award in 2013 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref>
* Best Paper Award Econometrics <ref name="econometrics">{{cite journal | title= ''Econometrics'' Best Paper Award 2018| journal=Econometrics | volume=6 | issue=3 | page=38 | doi=10.3390/econometrics6030038 | doi-access=free | last1=Choi | first1=In | last2=Cook | first2=Steve | last3=Paolella | first3=Marc S. | last4=Racine | first4=Jeffrey S. | year= 2018| url=https://cronfa.swan.ac.uk/Record/cronfa46250/Download/0046250-06122018132219.pdf }}</ref>
* [[Statistical Society of Canada]] Gold Medalist 2019<ref name="SSC-2019">{{cite web | url=https://ssc.ca/en/awards/2019/bruno-remillard | title=SSC Award Winners in 2019 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref>
* Fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] 2019<ref name="IMS-2019">{{cite web | url=https://imstat.org/2019/05/15/congratulations-to-the-2019-ims-fellows/ | title=IMS fellow 2019 | access-date=4 June 2021}}</ref>
